**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/01/24 (Tue) 10:33
- [PREFERENCE] User is interested in creating a classic style beat-em-up side scrolling fighting game.
- [PREFERENCE] User likes games similar to "Ninja Turtles IV - Turtles in Time", "Streets of Rage", "Spiderman: Maximum Carnage", and "Scott Pilgrim Vs The World".
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The game would be called "Save Grandma!".
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The protagonist must fight through hordes of zombies to reach and save their grandmother.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The game would feature a single player mode.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Levels would include a variety of environments such as city streets, parks, and suburban neighborhoods.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Each environment would have its own set of zombies and bosses to fight.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The game would include a variety of weapons such as baseball bats, crowbars, and chainsaws.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Players would have access to special moves and combos to deal extra damage to zombies.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] If the game had an endless mode, levels would be procedurally generated to keep gameplay fresh.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Survival mode would include a well-designed scoring system, leaderboard, and different rewards for milestones.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The recommended game engine is Unity, which supports 2D and 3D game development.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The game would be launched on multiple platforms: Windows, Mac, iOS, Android, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] For monetization, options include a paid game with no in-app purchases, a free-to-play model with in-app purchases, or a subscription-based model.
